item.title: Kono Koi, Seishun ni Yori.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: More
  • 発売日: 2016-04-28
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (75 人評価)
  • 日本語名: この恋、青春により。
  • 英語名: Kono Koi, Seishun ni Yori.

别名

  • 在青春的那段恋情

あらすじ

Spring has come once more to Sakuraba Gakuen and the students pass through the school gates with new hopes.

Ace pitcher Katsuya wishes to make the nationals after falling short last year.

Class rep Chiharu wishes to change herself by revealing her hidden feelings.

Osananajimi and manager Kyouko wishes to go to the nationals together with him.

item.title: Himawari to Koi no Kioku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: More
  • 発売日: 2014-12-26
  • スコア: 7.35/10 (72 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ヒマワリと恋の記憶
  • 英語名: Himawari to Koi no Kioku

别名

  • 向日葵与恋爱的记忆

あらすじ

Youth only comes once in a lifetime. It’s the time to go out and play with friends, do your best to achieve your dreams, and fall in love. Yuu is a second-year student at Ishigami Gakuen who is wasting his youth away. He thinks that he should do something about it, but lacks the motivation to take the first step. He soon meets four girls who have their own worries: Ai, the school’s #1 beauty who calls herself a delinquent; Akane, his classmate who yearns for the spotlight; Shiori, a quiet girl who is looking for ghosts; and Kana, his osananajimi who wants to get along with her friends once more. He spends precious time with each of them in turn.

item.title: Ayame no Machi to Ohime-sama
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: More
  • 発売日: 2013-12-20
  • スコア: 6.44/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あやめの町とお姫様
  • 英語名: Ayame no Machi to Ohime-sama

别名

  • Ayahime

あらすじ

Testuya recently had been seeing the same mysterious dream, with a lonely kimono-clad girl gazing at the moon in the middle of an open grassy field. He returned to his hometown of Koga after four years in Tokyo and was a bit saddened to see his place of memories changed due to recent development. One night, he headed to his favourite place, the garden of irises Ayame-en, and was startled to find a girl there who looked like the girl in his dreams. He joined the archaeology research group that she was a part of with the intention of getting to know her. Contrary to his initial impression, Ayame was a hardcore gamer, lacked common sense and called herself a princess from the Sengoku era.

item.title: Shukusai no Utahime -Kimi to Tsumugu Asu e no Uta-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: More
  • 発売日: 2013-03-29
  • スコア: 6.3/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 祝祭の歌姫 ―君と紡ぐ明日への歌―
  • 英語名: Shukusai no Utahime -Kimi to Tsumugu Asu e no Uta-

あらすじ

This is the first title by MORE. Kaito spent peaceful days in the musical capital of Wolfburg with his childhood friends Rio and Graf. However, his wish for this to remain unchanged was shattered one day when he heard a girl cry for help in a corner of the old town. He brought the girl Yuina to his house and after talking to his father, allowed her to temporarily stay with them since she had no place to call home due to strife. Thus began his life together with Yuina, whose values were quite different from his.
